g.text: marks a foreign key enforced by the database;
marks a relation that only exists in the
application. The schema declares exactly two
(ON DELETE SET NULL); Passport's tables are
joined through indexes only, and client_id has
not even that. Passport's tables are drawn with
the columns that matter here, not all of them.
gif_id is the GIPHY identifier: the catalog
is external, so no local "gifs" table exists.
